categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production and sales of turbocharger key components, specifically compressor shells and turbine shells. These are critical zero-parts for turbochargers used in automotive powertrains. The company also operates in emerging areas including hydrogen fuel cell ship propulsion systems and solid-state battery technology development through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core production processes involve casting and CNC machining. For compressor shells, aluminum alloy materials are cast and machined; for turbine shells, nickel plate, ferroniobium, and stainless steel are used. The company employs advanced techniques including 3D printing technology for mold-making, automated production lines, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. Quality control systems include IATF-16949 certification and continuous process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global turbocharger manufacturers including Garrett Motion, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, BMTS Technology (formerly Bosch Mahle), Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries, BorgWarner, and domestic manufacturers. End-market applications include major automotive brands such as BMW, Audi, Volkswagen, General Motors, Toyota, Honda, Ford, Great Wall, Geely, SAIC, and GAC. Products are used in both traditional fuel vehicles and increasingly in hybrid and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It serves both domestic and international markets, with significant export operations. The company has established relationships with customers across North America, Europe, Asia, and other regions. Subsidiaries operate in Dalian (hydrogen fuel cell ships) and Jiaxing (emerging technology development).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the automotive supply chain as a Tier-1 supplier of critical turbocharger components. It supplies directly to turbocharger manufacturers (Tier-1 suppliers to OEMs) rather than directly to vehicle manufacturers. The company controls its own casting and machining operations, maintaining vertical integration in core production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategy emphasizes 'stabilizing the main business while pursuing transformation.' R&D priorities include: developing new energy vehicle components (hybrid and fuel cell applications), advancing 3D printing and intelligent manufacturing technologies, expanding hydrogen fuel cell ship propulsion systems, and exploring solid-state battery technology through joint ventures. The company obtained 85 new projects in 2024 (46 traditional fuel vehicle, 39 new energy projects) and holds 196 valid patents including 36 invention patents.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured turbocharger components to global turbocharger manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers' designated warehouses or upon customer pickup. The company uses a direct sales model for most customers, with limited use of distributors (only for specific Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Japan products). Payment terms typically range from 60-135 days after delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global turbocharger market is dominated by five major manufacturers (Garrett, BorgWarner, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ishikawajima-Harima, and BMTS) controlling over 90% market share. The company positions itself as a leading Chinese supplier with 30+ years of experience in turbocharger components, competing on cost advantages, quality, large-scale production capacity, and rapid response capabilities. The company faces increasing competition from market consolidation and price pressures from OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated RMB 1.52 billion in revenue in 2024 (down 4.95% from 2023's RMB 1.60 billion) with net profit of RMB 55.5 million (down 17.90% from 2023). Total assets were RMB 2.03 billion at year-end 2024. The company has experienced revenue fluctuations due to traditional fuel vehicle market decline, though new energy vehicle components showed 80.87% revenue growth. Operating cash flow improved to RMB 242.8 million in 2024 from RMB 205.1 million in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) advanced quality management systems and IATF-16949 certification ensuring stable product quality; (2) intelligent and green manufacturing combining automation with environmental sustainability; (3) comprehensive R&D capabilities enabling rapid new product development and customization; (4) large-scale production capacity with flexible manufacturing; (5) established relationships with global tier-1 suppliers providing supply chain stability; (6) expansion into emerging technologies (hydrogen fuel cells, solid-state batteries) positioning for future market opportunities.
